title: Qualify pure diamond DAG sharing and bounded cycle research oracles
commitMessage: docs: qualify pure M7 diamond DAG research oracles

contribution.summary: Qualify M7-W01-C03-S01-T1 as bounded pure DAG research. Run an independent four-node/four-edge diamond yielding root 13 and one shared-node evaluation, then refuse cycles, unknown/duplicate references, excess node/edge/depth quotas and checked overflow without partial results. Complete T1 Q/O/D only; no DAG engine, AURA scheduling, PlotModel or package delivery.
contribution.value: Stage a BCL-only deterministic DAG witness and exact owner/research boundaries with a SHA-pinned local receipt. Refusals are checked before numerical evaluation where possible; checked arithmetic overflow returns no partial result. S01 remains active for T2, while S02 and original size-L C03 remain unstarted.
debtChanges: Do not advertise a Math DAG evaluator from independent finite BCL research oracles and manual topological fixtures.
Limit graph execution to a specifically admitted operation/consumer; test cycles, unknown nodes, invalid operands and finite node/edge/depth budgets.
Proof of memoized pure shared values does not authorize caches for impure callbacks or AURA job scheduling.
PlotModel S02, size-L C03 aggregate and M7 gate remain pending; no graphical renderer or external provider has been qualified.

Close S01 only on independent deferral or bounded admission; then separately qualify PlotModel S02 and 1/x segment breaks.
